roster.role: the Grand Tour — Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune
roster.note: the only spacecraft to visit all four giant planets, and the only close look humanity has ever had at Uranus and Neptune
flew Jupiter and Saturn, turned to photograph the whole solar system, and became the first human-made object to reach interstellar space

roster.name: The Golden Record
roster.note: a gold-plated phonograph record bolted to each craft — sounds, music, and greetings from Earth, aimed at whoever might find it in a billion years

roster.name: The Pale Blue Dot
roster.note: on 14 February 1990, from beyond Neptune, Voyager 1 turned back and photographed the Earth as a single pixel

roster.name: Interstellar space
roster.note: Voyager 1 crossed the heliopause in 2012, Voyager 2 in 2018 — the first machines to leave the Sun's bubble and enter the space between the stars, still calling home
